sections.title: باب 5 — متن (212)

paras.text: … we review its objective circumstances, then we will easily realise this reality, that within Pakistan there is present the ability to become a modern Islamic welfare state. If the common citizen performs the following duties, then very soon we can bring about the establishment of an Islamic welfare state.

paras.pashto: … د هغه عیني حالات وڅېړو، نو په اسانۍ به دا حقیقت درک کړو چې په پاکستان کې د یوه عصري اسلامي هوساینپال دولت کېدو وړتیا شته. که عام اتباع لاندې دندې سرته ورسوي، نو ډېر ژر به اسلامي هوساینپال دولت جوړ کړای شو.

paras.text: b. For the building of the nation, do not refrain from sacrifice and self-sacrifice of any kind.
paras.urdu: ب۔ تعمیرِ ملت کے لیے کسی قسم کی قربانی اور ایثار سے گریز نہ کریں۔
paras.pashto: ب. د ملت د جوړونې لپاره له هېڅ ډول قربانۍ او ایثار ډډه مه کوئ.

paras.text: c. Refrain from giving and taking bribes, so that merit may be supreme.

paras.text: e. Pass a peaceful life of mutual brotherhood and love.

sections.theory:
… we review its objective circumstances, then we will easily realise this reality, that within Pakistan there is present the ability to become a modern Islamic welfare state. If the common citizen performs the following duties, then very soon we can bring about the establishment of an Islamic welfare state.

a. Abide by the law and urge others to respect the law.

b. For the building of the nation, do not refrain from sacrifice and self-sacrifice of any kind.

c. Refrain from giving and taking bribes, so that merit may be supreme.

d. Do not adopt avarice, greed and lust, because corruption is born from them.

e. Pass a peaceful life of mutual brotherhood and love.

f. Acquire as much purposeful education as possible, so that our abilities increase.

g. Bring improvement in your morals and character, so that others are impressed and they too come to possess good character.

h. Always mind your own work; do not criticise others without need.

i. In general elections give the vote of confidence to competent and honest leadership.

j. Practise self-accountability, so that a culture of national accountability may flourish.

Exercise

Question 1: Write the answers to the following questions in detail.

a. With which problems are Muslims grappling in non-Muslim states?

b. Which motives were included in the formation of Pakistan?

c. Is Pakistan an Islamic welfare state?

d. What are the prominent features of a welfare state?

e. State the duties of a responsible citizen.

sections.content:
… we review its objective circumstances, then we will easily realise this reality, that within Pakistan there is present the ability to become a modern Islamic welfare state. If the common citizen performs the following duties, then very soon we can bring about the establishment of an Islamic welfare state.

a. Abide by the law and urge others to respect the law.

b. For the building of the nation, do not refrain from sacrifice and self-sacrifice of any kind.

c. Refrain from giving and taking bribes, so that merit may be supreme.

d. Do not adopt avarice, greed and lust, because corruption is born from them.

e. Pass a peaceful life of mutual brotherhood and love.

f. Acquire as much purposeful education as possible, so that our abilities increase.

g. Bring improvement in your morals and character, so that others are impressed and they too come to possess good character.

h. Always mind your own work; do not criticise others without need.

i. In general elections give the vote of confidence to competent and honest leadership.

j. Practise self-accountability, so that a culture of national accountability may flourish.

Exercise

Question 1: Write the answers to the following questions in detail.

a. With which problems are Muslims grappling in non-Muslim states?

b. Which motives were included in the formation of Pakistan?

c. Is Pakistan an Islamic welfare state?

d. What are the prominent features of a welfare state?

e. State the duties of a responsible citizen.

اس کے معروضی حالات کا جائزہ لیں تو ہم با آسانی اس حقیقت کا ادراک کر لیں گے کہ پاکستان کے اندر ایک جدید اسلامی فلاحی ریاست بننے کی صلاحیت موجود ہے۔ اگر عام شہری درج ذیل فرائض سرانجام دیں تو ہم بہت جلد اسلامی فلاحی ریاست کا قیام عمل میں لا سکتے ہیں۔

ا۔ قانون کی پابندی کریں اور دوسروں کو قانون کی پاسداری کی تلقین کریں۔

ب۔ تعمیرِ ملت کے لیے کسی قسم کی قربانی اور ایثار سے گریز نہ کریں۔

ج۔ رشوت دینے اور لینے سے احتراز کریں تاکہ میرٹ کی بالادستی ہو۔

د۔ حرص، لالچ اور ہوس اختیار نہ کریں کیونکہ اس سے کرپشن جنم لیتی ہے۔

ہ۔ پرامن اور باہمی اخوت و محبت والی زندگی گزاریں۔

و۔ زیادہ سے زیادہ بامقصد تعلیم حاصل کریں تاکہ ہماری صلاحیتوں میں اضافہ ہو۔

ز۔ اپنے اخلاق و کردار میں بہتری لائیں تاکہ دوسرے متاثر ہوں اور وہ بھی اچھے کردار کے مالک بن جائیں۔

ح۔ ہمیشہ اپنے کام سے کام رکھیں بلاضرورت دوسروں پر تنقید نہ کریں۔

ط۔ عام انتخابات میں اہل اور ایمان دار قیادت کو اعتماد کا ووٹ دیں۔

ی۔ خود احتسابی کریں تاکہ قومی احتساب کا کلچر پروان چڑھے۔

مشق

سوال 1: درج ذیل سوالوں کے جواب تفصیل سے لکھیں۔

ا۔ غیر مسلم ریاستوں میں مسلمان کن مسائل سے نبرد آزما ہیں؟

ب۔ پاکستان کی تشکیل میں کون کون سے محرکات شامل تھے؟

ج۔ کیا پاکستان ایک اسلامی فلاحی ریاست ہے؟

د۔ فلاحی ریاست کے نمایاں خدوخال کیا ہوتے ہیں؟

ہ۔ ذمہ دار شہری کے فرائض بیان کریں۔
